articles.title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
articles.snippet: Ledger’s Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instragram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

articles.title: BlackRock's crypto ETF assets surge 63% but remain far below 2025 peak
articles.snippet: The asset manager's crypto assets surged 63% to $79.6 billion as investors returned, but holdings remain 23% below year-ago levels.

articles.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.
